state.acceptanceRules: Evaluate aggregate boundary design, not whether a command route or test is complete. stateAndGrowth.lifetimeReplay: Every reassessment/renewed acceptance remains in lists and replay; no lifetime bound.

rows.contention: One risk phase/treatment/acceptance context needs serialization; independent old facts only increase rehydration. Governance owner changes occur in separate stream and are checked at admission.
rows.events: Assessment/treatment/acceptance are business facts. Accepted personal risk decision is obligation/fact. No refusal/technical receipt events.
rows.crossOwner: RiskMethodVersionView, ownerMemberId, authority bool and accepted-treatment bool are admission values from owning services. Live waiver object is queried with Allows. Program/owner eligibility must remain admission, not continuous rule enforced in this stream.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation

rows.name: RiskGovernanceLedger
rows.invariant: Within each risk/control tuple, one pending treatment assertion and one accepted version per control; independent review controls acceptance. Within one treatment action, only unfinished work can edit/cancel and completion needs current fulfilled evidence plus independent review.
rows.splitTest: No rule spans different risks. Split per-risk current governance first; then per-control treatment assertion and per-action lifecycle. Preserve per-control supersession by tuple-derived stream, keep action accountable/submitter+review context atomic, and pass risk treatment/fulfilled evidence admission proofs. Trigger inbox/status is a projection/process concern.
rows.identity: tenant/risk-governance/programId; child riskId/treatmentId/actionId, per-risk logical revision, physical program OCC. TriggerId derived from risk/kind/source. Action edit has complete stable intent tuple; submit replay only sees submissionId and several reviews lack replay handling.

stateAndGrowth.retained: Every program risk with owner, all treatment assertions, all triggers, every action/completion history, proposer/submitter/cancellation/edit request maps.
stateAndGrowth.lifetimeReplay: Risks/actions/triggers/edit and completion retries grow command state and replay indefinitely.

rows.contention: All risks share physical append; within one risk every unrelated action/trigger increments the same logical revision.
rows.events: Owner assignment, reviewed treatment assertion and action lifecycle are business facts. Reassessment trigger is an obligation fact if risk owner accepts required re-evaluation; do not erase it as technical notification. Immutable retry edit tuple is internal memory, not a separate event.
rows.crossOwner: Receives risk treatment kind and fulfilled evidence ID set as admission values, appropriate under rule13 if not claimed continuously current. Reviews accept live waiver and call Allows.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation

rows.name: RiskMethod
rows.invariant: The program method advances sequentially by expected published version and each immutable definition has complete valid 5x5 scales and permitted appetite.
rows.splitTest: Scales/appetite together define one method version and should remain atomic; historical versions can be immutable definition records read as values while narrow owner retains current version identity. No need split scale members.
rows.identity: tenant/risk-methods/v5(tenant,risk-method:program); versionId derives current sequential number. Publish lacks stable request identity; exact retry with original expectedVersion conflicts instead of no-op.

stateAndGrowth.retained: All method versions with full scales, appetite and author/time.
stateAndGrowth.lifetimeReplay: State/replay grows with every method publication; fixed scale size bounds one version only.

rows.contention: One program method publication line is a justified serial point, no other risk lifecycle writes share it.
rows.events: VersionPublished is a method definition fact, no technical acknowledgement events.
rows.crossOwner: Receives scalar program and definition values; no live aggregate.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation

rows.name: ImmutableSnapshot
rows.invariant: One snapshot identity can freeze exactly one canonical manifest/hash with immutable, attributed amendment lineage.
rows.splitTest: One immutable source capsule must be committed whole; amended snapshots already have separate identities and do not mutate parent.
rows.identity: Tenant / snapshots / context.RequestId minted creation identity; same canonical content/linkage/actor retries; one append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
rows.stateAndGrowth: Exactly one fact and manifest per root; replay bounded. Caller currently refuses lineage deeper than8 even though individual streams are bounded.
rows.contention: One creation only; amendments independent streams.
rows.events: Frozen snapshot is an accepted business source identity, while duplicate tenant/snapshot/actor/time fields overlap envelope. Event discriminator stability and detailed metadata policy await clarification of truncated rules 16/18; duplicate envelope fields were observed, not automatically removed.
rows.crossOwner: ScopeSnapshotFreezer checks authoritative owners and exact version projections at admission; root consumes manifest value, not live aggregate.
rows.decisionStatus: retained boundary; implementation findings remain

rows.name: PopulationSnapshot
rows.invariant: Freeze exactly one canonical immutable population identity, optionally a manifest over ordered immutable chunk identities; amendments have separate roots.
rows.splitTest: Rows may live outside root because immutable hashes/manifests bind exact order/count; root commit makes snapshot visible only after chunks exist. Current implementation has retry-based recovery, not a recovery reactor.
rows.identity: Tenant / population-snapshots / context.RequestId; retry compares exact content/lineage/actor; chunk keys deterministic; physical expected position. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
rows.stateAndGrowth: One fact per snapshot, up to500 inline rows otherwise compact manifest; lifetime replay constant. Parent lineage policy nevertheless rejects beyond8 links.
rows.contention: One freeze only; different snapshots independent.
rows.events: Business snapshot freeze remains domain fact; technical storage chunks should not be independent domain facts. Event discriminator stability and detailed metadata policy await clarification of truncated rules 16/18; duplicate envelope fields were observed, not automatically removed.
rows.crossOwner: Freezer reads predecessor before passing root identity; aggregate accepts values. Chunk contents verified by PopulationSnapshotContent outside root.
rows.decisionStatus: retained boundary; implementation findings remain
